Bay of Bengal Depression Targets Odisha and Andhra Pradesh with Heavy Rain

A deep depression over the Bay of Bengal is projected to cross the Odisha and Andhra Pradesh coasts, with forecasts indicating heavy to very heavy rainfall. Extremely heavy rain is possible in isolated areas. The system is expected to bring significant precipitation to southern and coastal Odisha.
